description: This file defines a PHP class 'cssmin' that provides methods for minifying CSS code, converting CSS to array structures, and encoding/decoding URLs within CSS. It also includes helper functions for handling CSS arrays and URL encoding.

classes.name: cssmin
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to minify CSS, parse CSS into structured arrays, and handle URL encoding/decoding within CSS.

methods.name: minify
methods.description: Minifies CSS by removing comments, unnecessary spaces, and optional semicolons, with options for URL preservation.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts CSS definitions into a structured array form for easier manipulation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a structured CSS array back into a CSS string.
